before.requirement: Link the libcares.a archive produced by the old build.
before.reason: The old test recipe links root libcares.la, and the harness links the corresponding root archive path. The rules that produce the archive are not supplied.

after.requirement: Link the libcares.a archive produced by the changed build.
after.reason: The changed library target and test links point to src/lib, while the harness still names the root archive. The supplied build rules do not establish that the root archive is absent.

source_evidence.quote:
EXTRA_DIST = fuzzcheck.sh CMakeLists.txt Makefile.m32 Makefile.msvc README.md buildconf
arestest_LDADD = libgmock.la $(ARES_BLD_DIR)/src/lib/libcares.la $(PTHREAD_LIBS)
aresfuzz_LDADD = $(ARES_BLD_DIR)/src/lib/libcares.la
aresfuzzname_LDADD = $(ARES_BLD_DIR)/src/lib/libcares.la
dnsdump_LDADD = $(ARES_BLD_DIR)/src/lib/libcares.la

claims.reason: The same old link command names $SRC/c-ares/.libs/libcares.a on both sides. The supplied source points to a library move but does not establish archive availability at that path on either side.
missing_information: Read the before and after top-level Makefile.am and configure.ac build rules to determine archive production and directory recursion.
The before and after top-level Makefile.am and configure.ac rules that determine which library directories make all builds and whether a root libcares archive is produced.
